_README: Harry's standard answers to the questions application forms ask, in one
place, for when he fills one in by hand. No code reads this file.
Anything null is 'I don't know' - worth filling in before it is needed.
notice_period is deliberately not a number. He started at Hydro Group on
24 August 2026 and has not said what his notice is, and a guessed figure
here is one that ends up in front of an employer as though it were fact.
security_clearance says he holds NONE, and that is not a detail to tidy.
It once read 'DV (Developed Vetting)', which is false - his clearance
lapsed at discharge. An automated state commit reverted this whole file
to that version on 31 August 2026 and the false claim sat in a public
repo until 3 September. tests/test_job_machine.py now runs the same
CLEARANCE_CLAIM regex that guards outgoing email against this file, so a
repeat fails the build instead of going unnoticed.

_never_auto_filled: Anything in this list is refused by code even if you put a value here, because
getting it wrong on your behalf is worse than a flagged application:
national insurance number, passport number, bank or sort code details,
date of birth, criminal convictions, DBS, medical or health questions,
ethnicity, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability status.
Those forms get filled to the last safe field and then handed to you.
